about: Goal G0 says a skill's text changes only by an addition that tells the AI to record something. Stage seam-chaining makes the rule that the AI never runs the next command itself depend on a setting, so the text of every skill changes, though what the AI does stays the same while the setting grants no command.
question: Should G0 name the setting-dependent text that lets the AI run the next command as a second exception, under R-adf-11, holding only while no command is granted by default?
detail: From D-sc-8 in orbit/explore/seam-chaining/explore.md; the chaining map is D-sc-5 (absent = not granted).
